notes.TIMSS_label: LOCO source labels TIMSS G8 as 'TIMSS'; normalized to 'TIMSS_G8' here.
notes.RQ1_models: LOCO and tabular models across available program-domains, plus TimesFM 2.5/3.0 variants for PISA (LoRA+zero-shot) and TimesFM 2.5 zero-shot for TIMSS_G8/TIMSS_G4/PIRLS/ICCS/ICILS. Metrics are aggregated from different benchmark designs; compare with that limitation in mind.
notes.RQ2_delta: delta_MAE = MAE(M0) - MAE(M1); positive means M1 (lit-weighted Ridge) improves on M0 (unweighted Ridge).
notes.TimesFM_RQ2: LoRA is reported as a separate PISA adaptation comparison and is not treated as the structured predictor-weight knowledge-base intervention.
